name: Anthony S. Mendoza
headline: Full-Stack Software Engineer
summary: Software engineer on Zalio's founding team, building full-stack products with TypeScript, React, Next.js, Python and PostgreSQL. Experience delivering CRM workflows, AI marketing tools, voice-agent integrations and shared UI components, with automated testing and workflow automation.

experience.title: Junior Developer, Founding Team
bullets: Built the CRM's Campaign Tracker and Forms: a drag-and-drop form builder, campaign calendars and dashboards, with sign-ups attributed to the originating campaign and form.
Implemented secure lead-capture webhooks and Meta Lead Ads synchronization with duplicate prevention and explicit handling of closed forms.
Built core Zalio Marketing features: TikTok and Instagram trend discovery, AI creative briefs, and a timeline video editor with FFmpeg rendering to MP4.
Integrated Alex voice agents into lead-capture and calling workflows; added phone-menu navigation and voicemail handling, and reduced callback detection from 60 to 10 seconds.
Created Zalio UI, a shared component library and interactive documentation using React, TypeScript, shadcn/ui and Tailwind CSS.
Delivered 137 merged pull requests across six repositories, including regression-tested CRM and voice-agent changes.

experience.title: AI-Assisted Full-Stack Web Developer (Intern)
bullets: Built training prototypes exploring machine learning, AI features and game development.

projects.name: SAM - Service Automation Manager
bullets: Built a chat-based booking agent with n8n workflows that record bookings in Google Sheets, create calendar events, and pause until payment is confirmed.
Added a live trace panel so users can follow each automation step.

projects.name: BK Basketball League Platform
bullets: Built a real-time league platform for standings, schedules, player statistics and news using React and Firebase.
Implemented Firebase Authentication for admin box-score entry and automatic MVP selection; shipped an installable PWA with offline caching.
